name: buttress
description: Stepped buttress (扶壁): a 1-wide pier against a wall face, deepest at ground and tapering to 1 block at the top (3-2-1 profile).
when_to_use: Corners of towers/keeps/churches, or every 3-4 blocks along tall stone walls. Run once per buttress position. origin = the wall-face column it leans on, at ground level; the buttress grows OUTWARD from the wall.

origin.notes: wall-face column at ground level (the buttress itself is placed on the OUTER side)

side.notes: direction the buttress sticks out from the wall

height.notes: usually wall height or wall height minus 1-2
